subject: Contract for S14: assistant ask registry (apps/web/src/assistant/ask.ts)
body:
For whoever takes S14 (assistant). The flashcard review page's Stuck? panel (Hint / Explain) renders only while features.assistant is on AND a handler is registered, so a button never does nothing. In 18f0ec0 the old window 'naadi:assistant-ask' event is gone; use apps/web/src/assistant/ask.ts:
- registerAssistantAsk(handler) -> unregister. Call it when the assistant panel mounts (and can answer), call the returned function on unmount. Do NOT register in exam mode (the assistant is disabled there).
- handler(ask: { kind: 'hint' | 'explain'; context: { type: 'flashcard'; id: string } }): open the panel and answer with the card as page context. Read the card through the Cards API (GET /api/cards/{id}), which applies the graded-attempt gate; never reveal a gated question's answer.
- askAssistant(ask) -> boolean (false if nothing registered); useAssistantAvailable() -> boolean (useSyncExternalStore). The latest registration answers.
S14 owns apps/web/src/assistant/ from here: extend AssistantAsk.context with new types as other pages need them (keep 'flashcard' as is). Tests: apps/web/src/assistant/ask.test.ts.
